d:
Presenting Shankara, a Sitar for Mental Health musical tribute to Lord Shiva, channeling the beauty, power, and grace of Shringhar—the emotion of love and devotion from the theory of Navarasa (the nine emotions). For me, the name "Shankar" holds deep personal significance, from my guru, Pandit Ravi Shankar, to the divine connection with Lord Shiva. This festive composition celebrates the union of mankind with the divine.
Stream "Shankara" on all major platforms and join me in this celebration of the cosmic beauty of life:
Credits:
Song: Shankara
Songwriter & Producer: Rishab Rikhiram Sharma
